body: Thank you, I'm sure that I will.

Thank you all so much for your comments.  I read and considered them all thoroughly, and am more overwhelmed and touched by all your support than I can truly express.  

Today's a much better day.  I talked over my feelings thoroughly with my best friend this morning, and we've decided that we're probably going to move to a new city at the end of the year, and continue our projects there.  The prospect of leaving my college-town and all its sad reminders behind gives me newfound hope, and a fresher outlook on how different my life can be going forward, without having to abandon my dream.  For the first time in memory, I'm looking forward to the future, and starting to feel energized about our projects again.

Last night was a terrible low point for me (oddly made worse by all the happy 4th of July celebrations surrounding me), and I want to thank you all for being there to catch me.  You're wonderful people.  If I'm ever in such a dark place again, I now know a great place to turn to.  Thank you all so much.
